parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

> Call the [ListCheckItemWarningSummary](~~ListCheckItemWarningSummary~~) operation to obtain the check item ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason for adding the whitelist entry.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The ID of the whitelist record.

parameters.name: RemoveContainerUuids
parameters.description: The list of asset UUIDs for which container names are to be removed from the whitelist.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. Valid values:
- **default**: host
- **agentless**: agentless.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The type of the target on which the whitelist takes effect. Valid values:
- **all_instance**: all servers
- **instance**: specific servers.
